ModMetaData.name: VFE Pirates (HSK/CE Patched)
ModMetaData.author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, erdelf, Roolo, Smash Phil, Taranchuk, xrushha, Kikohi, legodude17 — HSK/CE patch by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
HSK/CE-patched version of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates, tuned for the Hardcore SK modpack.
Original mod by Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, erdelf, Roolo, Smash Phil, Taranchuk, xrushha, Kikohi, and legodude17. This patch version rebalances the mod's player-facing content to fit HSK's spacer-tier economy and bundles the community-made CE compatibility patches.
--- HSK-NATIVE TUNING ---
WARCASKETS — spacer-tier armor progression rebalanced to HSK crafting (spacer research, ComponentSpacer + Plasteel + StrongMetallic + Kevlar ingredients, TableMachining / MechWeaponCraftingWorkTable).
WARCASKET WEAPONS — 9 warcasket-only guns (Autorifle, UraniumSlugRifle, Slugthrower, Minigun, GrenadeLauncher, HeavyFlamer, ChargeLance, HandheldCannon, ChargeBlaster) routed to MechWeaponCraftingWorkTable at Charge_weapons_D/E research with HSK spacer-tier ingredients.
RUM + DRUGS — HSK-tighter pricing to match the modpack's gated crafting economy.
--- DISABLED PLAYER CONTENT ---
Removed from player architect menu (enemy base generation + raids still use them): - Cannon (VFEP_Turret_Cannon) — HSK has rich medieval-tier artillery - Field Gun (VFEP_Turret_FieldGun) — HSK has its own mortar/field-gun variants
Projectile defs preserved (enemy artillery still works) — only player-buildable turret entries hidden.
The Gauntlet Charge Cannon Ship Chunk (VFEP_ShipChunkGauntletTurret) is NOT disabled — it's an enemy-only event mechanic that pirates drop from orbit as ship debris. Not buildable by the player in vanilla; left fully intact so the pirate raid event continues to work.
--- CE-GATED TWEAK ---
Grappling Hook ability (VFEP_GrapplingHook) — stripped from Privateer Armor when Combat Extended is active. 20-cell teleport-through-walls interacts badly with CE's line-of-sight and movement systems. Privateer Armor remains fully craftable and functional; it just loses the grapple. Gated in Patches-CE/ so vanilla/non-CE installs are unaffected.
--- PRESERVED GAMEPLAY ---
Full pirate gameplay: - 3 factions (Pirates, Junkers, Pirate Mercenaries) - Hireables (mercenary contracts via comms console) - Warcasket system (chest/arm/head customization + abilities) - Ideology: Pirate meme with sea shanties + camaraderie precepts - Ethereal Skyfallers (raid drop-in) - Pirate-themed quests + scenarios - Custom mechanoid (Gauntlet-type) - Curses + pirate-specific ideology content
--- BUNDLED CE PATCHES ---
Community-made HSK CE patches (originally at G:\HSK CE patches\Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates\) bundled and gated by IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended" in loadFolders.xml. Covers: - 5 new CE ammo defs (WarBolter rockets, Slugthrower shells, Gauntlet turret ammo, Vikings + Bioferrite + Ammo Mods bridges) - All 9 warcasket weapons with full CE ballistics (Bulk, Ammo, ProjectileProperties_CE) - Warcasket apparel CE stats (Sharp/Blunt armor ratings, Bulk, WornBulk) - Gauntlet turret CE conversion (Building_TurretGunCE) - Cross-mod warcasket weapon addons (Vikings, Classical, Lightning, Quechua, Nitori, Bounty Hunters, Empire — only activate when those mods are loaded) - Mercenary + Junker pawnkind CE loadouts - Abilities, drugs, ideology precepts, scenarios — all CE-compatible
--- COMPATIBILITY ---
Requires: HSK (skyarkhangel.hsk), Combat Extended (CETeam.CombatExtended), Harmony, VE Framework. NOT compatible with the original "OskarPotocki.VFE.Pirates" — enable this INSTEAD. Not compatible with: n7huntsman.combatshields (inherited incompatibility from base mod).
